title: Cows chasing you? Let go of the dog 🐄🐕
caption:
The one thing that could save you in a field of cows 🐄⚠️
Save this before your next country walk 👇
sources: UK Health and Safety Executive / National Farmers' Union and the Ramblers: walking near cattle with dogs; if cattle threaten, let the dog go, move away calmly to the field edge; avoid getting between cows and calves
Fraser-Williams A. P. et al. (2016) 'Cattle-related injuries among walkers in the UK', Journal of Rural Health (dogs present in many incidents)
